profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Williams Sonoma
profile.summary: Production Support Lead with a focus on continuous process improvement by monitoring\implementing KPI's for identification, to implement solutions to drive efficiencies in daily ESRE operations by  of usage technical tools\automation and attain cost savings for the company. A proven track record of implementing processes for identifying issues quicker, defining framework for ESRE\ daily operations teams , being an  effective communicator and managing\stabilizing operational workflows across cross functional teams in case of disruptive events\technical incidents.

positions.title: Production Support Lead
positions.description:
Oversee production support functions for dropship  within OMS, integration with 3rd parties and related supply chain systems within Williams Sonoma. 
Collaborate with operations teams across geographies (China, India, USA) to help identify areas for process improvements, implement quicker solutions using available technical tools for immediate usage (if any), identify technical requirements for cross functional teams and work with product management\engineering\analytics teams to facilitate roadmap for future advanced implementation.
Define\monitor KPI's to analyze\baseline daily ordering\fulfillment flow performance within OMS, middleware and other integrated systems.
Identify issues before they become problems, implement workarounds and automate processes as needed.
Define standard operating procedures for ESRE\ops teams using technical tools for any repetitive events , to ensure time\cost saving.
Subject matter expert on monitoring tools like ELK, Appdynamics and helps implement\define framework for cross functional teams
Responsible for mentoring 6 member product support ESRE team across geographies\time zones
positions.insights: Sterling Commerce, Elastic Stack (ELK) and +5 skills

positions.title: Business Analyst and Production Support Lead
positions.description:
Manage dropship  order flows within OMS, integration with 3rd parties and related supply chain systems within Williams Sonoma. 
Work with 3rd party vendors, buyers and operational teams to identify problem areas, define workarounds and put in standard operating procedures.
Analyze monitoring tools, define framework for functional usage, educate ESRE teams about tools for daily operations
Responsible for monitoring\identifying areas of improvement for ESRE teams, implementing internal team functional reviews and recommend path for change.
